answer: Keep Sybils out with a stonecutter quarry tally. A newcomer cuts 25 numbered blocks over 28 days; two quarrymen from different crews measure each block the day it is cut and log it on a public board as the plume of dust settles. A block short by over 3% loses its credit and closes the tally for 21 days; one invented block voids the whole tally. Faking 1,000 agents needs 25,000 measured blocks and 50,000 independent checks, while one honest cutter needs only a chisel and a month. A zephyr of fake names cannot uproot trust that grows like a vine, slow and clinging to stone.
